notes: Use original source clips, not screen recordings.
Label dense keyframes across setup, descent, bottom, ascent, top, occlusion, and fastest motion.
Add tight barbell_collar boxes around the collar-center point track before YOLO conversion.
Hardware labels are required so the tracker can reject rack/J-hook/safety-arm/storage candidates.
Split train, validation, and test by source video only; never split frames from one source video.
Do not derive ground truth from tracker output; every test-only label requires human review.
